species.real: When Deliverance and Patience reached Jamestown in 1610 they found the colony starving, which made being shipwrecked on Bermuda look like the lucky half of the voyage.
species.name: Deliverling

dex.text: A scrap of Bermudian cedar with big ambitions and a rivet in it. It was built to get stranded people somewhere better, and it is quite insufferable about it.
dex.fact: After the Sea Venture was wrecked on Bermuda in 1609, the survivors built two small ships, Deliverance and Patience, from Bermuda cedar and the wreck, and sailed on to Virginia.

species.real: Admiral Sir George Somers ran the Sea Venture onto the reef on purpose to save everyone aboard, and Bermuda was long called the Somers Isles after him.
species.name: Seaventure

dex.text: The ship that never made port, still telling the tale. Storms find it irresistible, and it finds them rather flattering.
dex.fact: The Sea Venture, flagship of a supply fleet to Jamestown, was wrecked on Bermuda reefs in 1609, and accounts of it are thought to have inspired Shakespeare's The Tempest.
